name: Close all positions
summary: This EA is a utility tool that closes all open positions on the account. It does not open any trades itself; its sole function is to liquidate all existing positions, typically used as an emergency exit or account reset mechanism.
summary_zh: 这是一个工具型EA，功能是关闭账户上所有持仓。它本身不开仓，唯一功能是平掉所有现有仓位，通常用作紧急退出或账户重置手段。
strategy_analysis: 该EA没有交易策略概念，它不基于任何技术指标或信号入场。其唯一功能是遍历账户所有持仓并逐个平仓，属于纯粹的账户管理工具。出场条件即用户手动触发或满足预设条件时执行全仓平仓。仓位管理方面不涉及，因为该EA不建仓。资金管理方面同样不涉及，仅执行平仓操作。使用场景包括紧急止损、日内结算、或配合其他EA做风控联动。风险点在于平仓滑点和极端行情下无法及时平仓的可能性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy concept as it does not enter positions based on any technical indicators or signals. Its sole function is to iterate through all account positions and close them one by one, serving as a pure account management utility. Exit conditions are triggered by user manual action or preset conditions to execute full position liquidation. Position sizing is not applicable since the EA never opens positions. Money management is likewise not applicable as it only executes closing operations. Use cases include emergency stop-loss, end-of-day settlement, or risk control linkage with other EAs. Risk points include slippage during closure and inability to close positions promptly under extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: Close All
parameters.description: 触发平仓操作的开关参数
parameters.description_en: Switch parameter to trigger close-all operation

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定平仓的EA魔术号，0表示所有仓位

pros: 一键平仓所有持仓，操作简单高效
可作为风控工具配合其他EA使用，增强账户安全性
代码逻辑简单，易于理解和维护
减少手动逐个平仓的操作延迟
适用于紧急情况下的快速风险控制
pros_en: One-click close all positions, simple and efficient operation
Can serve as risk control toolused alongside other EAs，enhancing account safety
Simple code logic, easy to understand and maintain
Reduces operational delay from manually closing positions one by one
Suitable for rapid risk control in emergency situations
cons: 无法选择性平仓，全部平仓可能过于粗暴
没有滑点保护和重试机制，极端行情可能平仓失败
缺乏确认机制，容易误触导致意外全仓平仓
不区分盈利和亏损仓位，可能平掉盈利仓位
无法设置部分平仓或按比例平仓
cons_en: Cannot selectively close positions; closing all may be too aggressive
No slippage protection or retry mechanism; may fail under extreme market conditions
Lacks confirmation mechanism; easy to accidentally trigger full liquidation
Does not distinguish between profitable and losing positions; may close winning trades
Cannot set partial close or proportional closing of positions
improvements: 增加选择性平仓功能：按品种、方向、盈亏状态筛选平仓
添加确认对话框和防误触机制，避免意外全仓平仓
增加重试机制和滑点保护，提高极端行情下的平仓成功率
improvements_en: Add selective closing functionality: filter by symbol, direction, or profit/loss status
Add confirmation dialog and anti-accidental trigger mechanism to avoid unintended full liquidation
Add retry mechanism and slippage protection to improve closure success rate under extreme market conditions

risk_points: 极端行情下可能因滑点导致平仓失败
误触可能导致意外全仓平仓造成不必要损失
risk_points_en: May fail to close positions under extreme market conditions due to slippage
Accidental trigger may cause unintended full liquidation resulting in unnecessary losses
